# Paired statistics (auto-generated by experiments/rl_select/paper_figures.py)

Wilcoxon signed-rank (two-sided) on paired units; mean diff = first minus second (kNN BA); CI = bootstrap 95% of the mean paired difference; W/L/T = units where first > / < / = second. Holm correction applied within each group. Units are seed-averaged repeat x fold (S2) or fold x seed (S3) and are NOT independent across targets/n/variants: pooled p-values are optimistic, so cell-level rows (one mean per target x source x n cell) are given as a conservative check.
